_comment: Hand-curated aliases CLDR does not carry: ISO 3166 official long names, plus
colloquial and superseded names that still appear in film metadata.
Keys and values are matched after slugification; values are ISO alpha-2 codes.
Defunct states (Soviet Union, Yugoslavia, Czechoslovakia, West Germany) are
deliberately absent — they are not ISO 3166-1 territories, so they pass through
untranslated and keep their own origin= value.
